topic: Country with the most adults living with diabetes: China — 148.0 million adults aged 20–79 (IDF Diabetes Atlas 11th ed., 2025, data for 2024), about 1 in 4 of the 589 million worldwide; India 89.8 million second; United States ≈ 38 million (CDC 38.4 M all ages, 2021); worldwide 11.1 % of adults, ~4 in 10 undiagnosed globally and about half in the Western Pacific; World Diabetes Day 14 November = Frederick Banting's birthday (insulin discovered in Toronto, 1921)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: The United States has the most people with diabetes.
myths.reality: China has about 148 million adults with diabetes, India about 90 million; the United States has about 38 million.

idf_atlas.title: IDF Diabetes Atlas, 11th edition (2025)
idf_atlas.notes: 589 million adults (20–79) with diabetes in 2024, 11.1 % of adults; China 148.0 million (most), India 89.8 million (second); 4 in 10 undiagnosed worldwide

idf_wp_factsheet.title: IDF Atlas 11th edition — Western Pacific factsheet
idf_wp_factsheet.notes: China accounts for 1 in 4 of all adults living with diabetes worldwide; half of adults with diabetes in the region are undiagnosed

cdc_ndsr.title: National Diabetes Statistics Report
cdc_ndsr.notes: 38.4 million Americans of all ages have diabetes (11.6 % of the population), about 8.7 million undiagnosed

who_wdd.title: World Diabetes Day — 14 November
who_wdd.notes: marked on 14 November, the birthday of Sir Frederick Banting, who co-discovered insulin with Charles Best in 1921

britannica_banting.title: Frederick Banting
britannica_banting.notes: born 14 November 1891; discovered insulin with Charles Best at the University of Toronto in 1921; Nobel Prize 1923

medicaldialogues_idf.title: IDF Diabetes Atlas 11th edition — key takeaways from India
medicaldialogues_idf.notes: India 89.8 million adults with diabetes in 2024, second only to China; 43 % undiagnosed

who_diabetes.title: Diabetes — fact sheet
who_diabetes.notes: about 830 million people had diabetes in 2022 (all ages, 18+ at 14 %); more than half of adults with diabetes were not on medication; China and India hold the most people with diabetes
